This card bears your permanent Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN).
Always indicate your TIN on all returns/documents filed with the BIR.
Issuance of TIN Card for the first time shall be free of charge. However,
in case of subsequent issuance upon taxpayer's request due to loss or
damage, a P100.00 fee shall be collected to cover cost of reprinting.
Report immediately to your Revenue District Officer, the loss of this card
and change of name or address.
Any person who secures and/or uses more than one TIN shall be
criminally liable and shall be punishable by fine and imprisonment.
